name: lean-ctx
description: Context Engineering for AI Agents — 84 MCP tools, 10 read modes, 95+ shell patterns, tree-sitter AST for 27 languages. Compresses LLM context by up to 99%. Use when reading files, running shell commands, searching code, or exploring directories. Auto-installs if not present.
author: yvgude
summary_zh: 面向 AI Agent 的上下文工程工具，适合读文件、搜代码和执行命令时压缩上下文，降低 Token 消耗。
